run_prerelax_multiple_structures: run CHGNet prerelaxation on multiple crystal structures from a generated file and save results to JSON
run_prerelax_cli: run the prerelaxation script via CLI on structures from cdvae, diffcsp, or rfm model outputs
run_prerelax_on_slurm: run distributed CHGNet prerelaxation jobs across a SLURM cluster with configurable parallelism
review_wait_for_jobs_to_finish: review the wait_for_jobs_to_finish function that polls submitit jobs until all complete
review_prerelax_multiple: review the prerelax_multiple function that loads structures, runs CHGNet relaxation, and collects energy data
